about: Measured CUDA execution-shape references for tools/run_suite.py.
One entry per scene. Each entry is the whole-run summary of the two per-step
indicator streams the solver writes into <session>/output/data/, plus the
0.25 s window means a truncated run is compared on.
CUDA is the oracle. compare_shape() fails a comparison whose reference was
recorded on any other backend, so a backend can never certify itself.
A scene absent from `scenes` has never been measured. The gate reports it as
`no-reference`, names it in the summary with the command that produces one,
and under --shape-gate strict fails on it. Under the default --shape-gate
measured it does not fail, because an unmeasured scene is this file's debt
rather than a finding about the backend under test. Produce one on a CUDA
host, with the reference host's ~/.cache/ppf-cts in place so a
tetrahedralized scene keeps one mesh:
python tools/run_suite.py --backend cuda --only <scene> --record-reference
`band` at the top level is the default ratio window; see SHAPE_BAND in
run_suite.py for how 2.0 was constructed and what size of defect it can and
cannot see. A scene entry may carry its own `band`, and must then also carry
a `band_source` naming the measurement that set it, or compare_shape()
refuses the band and fails the comparison.
Owed: every scene in examples/*.ipynb except `drape`, and `walkthrough`,
which creates no session and writes no streams.

domino.band_source: measured envelope over 4 consecutive CUDA runs on one tree (run_suite --repeat 4), plus 3 further runs during the slot-replay A/B: iter.mean 27.61 .. 252.1 and iter.median 24 .. 155, against a reference mean of 54.07, so a single run reaches 4.66x on the mean and 5.54x on the median with no code change at all. iter.count held 1.0072x and every newton_steps statistic held 1.0000x to 1.0072x over the same runs, so those stay at the default band: only the two per-solve statistics are widened.

source: checked in beside this file. Derived from those files by
run_suite.py profile_from_files(), and run_suite.py --self-test case A
re-derives it and fails on any drift, so this entry cannot disagree with
The streams are a complete 101-frame examples/drape run of the reference
CUDA build, captured during the divergence audit by the A/B script that
also produced the two defective runs beside them (baseline, then
invert() -> identity, then restore). Its whole-run mean is 323.0755,
against 936.4 for the identity-preconditioner run captured beside it.
HOST UNRECORDED. The capture script names no host, and this file does not
guess one. cg-iteration counts need per-host re-baselining (about 10%
between hosts on examples/headless.py), so the band is set wide enough
to absorb that; see SHAPE_BAND in run_suite.py.
Independent corroboration, recorded after the fix and used by
--self-test case B: two further complete CUDA drape runs read
(790 solves, mean 320.6, median 372) and (802, 318.5, 369), and the Metal
backend with its preconditioner wired reads (793, 322.8, 370).
drape.vertices_note: 5 sheets of app.mesh.square(res=128), so 5 * 128 * 128 = 81920 dynamic vertices (rectangle_with_uv allocates res_x * res_y, crates/ppf-cts-core/src/datamodel/mesh.rs:638). drape carries no tetrahedralization, so this count must match exactly on any host; a solid scene's will not unless the asset caches match.

plastic.band_source: measured envelope over 4 consecutive CUDA runs on one tree (run_suite --repeat 4) plus 3 further runs: iter.mean 469 .. 1110 against a reference of 1116, and iter.median 264 .. 1014 against 880, so the median reaches 0.30x unaided. Note the 4-run envelope UNDERSTATED the median range as 332 .. 1014; a fifth run fell below it, which is why this band is set from the wider observed range rather than from the repeat alone. iter.count held 1.089x and newton_steps.count 1.075x, so those stay at the default band. This is the scene that occasionally does not complete.
